description: READ-ONLY sales ranking per product for the POS product picker (ProductListPage, /product/:categoryId), so the list opens ordered by best seller. Projection over EXISTING tables only: SUM(dbo.incomeDetails.quantity) grouped by productId, joined to dbo.income for companyId + paymentDate, over a rolling window (default last 90 days, America/Hermosillo dates). NO NEW TABLE: do not create dbo.productSalesRankings; the fields below describe the result row, not columns to persist. Single action 'get' on sp_productSalesRanking(@pjsonfile) taking {"productSalesRanking":[{"companyId":1,"categoryId":1002,"days":90}]}; categoryId optional (NULL = all categories of the company); days optional (default 90, clamp 1..365). Returns every product of the company/category, including products with zero sales (LEFT JOIN from dbo.products so new items still appear, unitsSold=0), ordered unitsSold DESC, then name ASC. Multi-tenant: always filter dbo.products.companyId AND dbo.income.companyId by the requested companyId.

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Optional filter on dbo.products.categoryId. NULL = all categories.

fields.name: days
fields.description: Rolling window in days over dbo.income.paymentDate. Default 90, clamp 1..365. Request-only.

fields.name: unitsSold
fields.description: Result row: SUM(incomeDetails.quantity) in the window; 0 when the product has no sales.

fields.name: salesRank
fields.description: Result row: 1-based position, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unitsSold DESC, products.name ASC).

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId on both products and income.
One ranking row per product (LEFT JOIN products -> incomeDetails -> income).

components.name: productSalesRankingApi
components.description: src/api/productSalesRankingApi.ts: getProductSalesRanking({companyId, categoryId, days}) -> {productId, unitsSold, salesRank}[]. ProductListPage adds 'Más vendidos' as the DEFAULT option of its existing A-Z / Z-A IonSegment, ordering by salesRank; on API failure fall back to A-Z silently (log with the module prefix).

endpoints.description: Thin route -> modules/productSalesRanking.py -> EXEC [dbo].[sp_productSalesRanking] @pjsonfile. Read-only; no audit log needed.
